## [1.3.0](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-23)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **CK Zombies - Stop requests to dead servers:** Drop emptied SDK hosts from the DEX string pool ([e05d0de](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/morphe-patches/commit/e05d0def5f9f6cb34d06b35601cfa20e8207443d))
* **CKZ Origins - Disable telemetry:** Drop emptied SDK hosts from the DEX string pool ([61ab94d](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/morphe-patches/commit/61ab94de66e2411b6a02dab91e486f40db0e36a7))

### ✨ New Features

* **Dead Crossing:** Add `Disable telemetry` patch ([d2b491d](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/morphe-patches/commit/d2b491da5ac23fb013f4e548f16ad6c8711e5e11))
* **Dead Crossing:** Add `Modern Android compatibility` patch ([f45f1f9](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/morphe-patches/commit/f45f1f9393694a91bcb04d0f37f4a527376a7ab4))
* **Dead Crossing:** Add `Remove unused permissions` patch ([73991d4](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/morphe-patches/commit/73991d4ff1b040ef39eb2013c9c861809eabd4bd))
* **Dead Crossing:** Add `Unlimited currency` patch ([d3b363a](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/morphe-patches/commit/d3b363a019096af2bdfaa4ec77c1d770ff49928b))

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops the game from sending usage data to analytics and ad services.

patches.name: Modern Android compatibility
patches.description: Fixes the crash at launch on current Android and targets API 25 so that Android 14 and later install the game normally.

patches.name: Remove unused permissions
patches.description: Removes permissions the game no longer needs, such as phone and accounts, along with the dead services that needed them.

patches.name: Unlimited currency
patches.description: A fresh install starts with 99,999,999 Glory and 99,999,999 Gold. If you install the patched app as an update, your current balance stays as it is.

patches.name: Disable explosion shake
patches.description: Stops the player fov shaking when something explodes.

patches.name: Disable friendly fire
patches.description: Makes civilians immune to the player's shots and explosions.

patches.name: Hide Daily Deal popup
patches.description: Hides the annoying Daily Deal popup that shows at every launch. The deal is still in the store.

patches.name: Modern Android compatibility
patches.description: Fixes the crash at launch on current Android and targets API 25 so that Android 14 and later install the game normally.

patches.name: Play intro once
patches.description: Plays the intro video on the first launch after installing, and skips it after that.

patches.name: Remove unused permissions
patches.description: Removes permissions the game no longer needs, such as phone and accounts, along with the dead services that needed them.

patches.name: Render menus at 720p
patches.description: Makes the menus, text and pictures full size on screens above 720p, where they are otherwise small. Menus are drawn at 720p and stretched to the screen, so they look slightly blurry. The 3D gameplay keeps the screen's own resolution and stays sharp.

patches.name: Show hidden weapons
patches.description: Shows the two hidden weapons, AA-2012 and Dual MP-643, in the store.

patches.name: Smooth sound
patches.description: Removes the stutter while firing, caused by the game building a new audio player for every sound.

patches.name: Stop requests to dead servers
patches.description: Removes the 30 second wait on the loading screen and the daily offline message, and stops the game from contacting Tapjoy, OpenFeint and Glu's dead servers.

patches.name: Unlimited ammo
patches.description: Ammo never decreases, and reloading still works.

patches.name: Unlimited currency
patches.description: A fresh install starts with 999,999,999 Glu credits and 999,999,999 Cash. If you install the patched app as an update, your current balance stays as it is.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops the game from sending usage data to analytics and ad services, and from contacting Glu's servers at launch.
